_how_to: Sources feeding the live orb. Each theme is one sector of the orb. Turn a source off with "enabled": false. Every source here is public; check the terms note before adding new ones.

ransomwatch.terms: Unlicense (public domain). Global posts, no country field.

ransomware_live.terms: Non-commercial use free with attribution; commercial use needs written approval. Off until cleared.

cisa_kev.terms: U.S. government public data. Attribute CISA.

nvd.terms: Public API; 5 requests/30s without a key, 50 with NVD_API_KEY. NVD asks for its notice: 'This product uses the NVD API but is not endorsed or certified by the NVD.'

statuspages.terms: Public Atlassian Statuspage endpoints (/api/v2/incidents.json). Confirm each page still uses Statuspage.

upptime.label: status
upptime.terms: Your own Upptime repo; downtime issues are read from the GitHub API. Check which label your Upptime repo puts on downtime issues.

rss.terms: Headlines and links only; no article text is stored.
